a.lede: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.
a.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search

b.lede: DuckDuckGo is courting schools frustrated by Google's AI restrictions, pointing educators to its search engine and options to disable AI features.
b.title: DuckDuckGo pitches itself to schools amid backlash over Google’s AI policy
